name: Healer's Gloves
text:
These clean, white gloves never show signs of blood, even when used to stitch up wounds or treat other ailments. They give you a +1 item bonus to Medicine checks.

---
Activate—Healer's Touch A (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You can soothe the wounds of a willing, living, adjacent creature, restoring 2d6+7 vitality,healing Hit Points to that creature. This is a healing vitality effect. You can't harm undead with this healing.
